sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Candy Strike Online is a color-matching game where players must match as many candies of the same color as possible within a set time limit. The game is easy to learn, but challenging to master, requiring quick reflexes and strategic thinking. Players can use mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to match candies, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.

The gameplay is fast-paced and exciting, with candies falling from the top of the screen in a steady stream. Players must match candies quickly to earn points and clear the board. As the game progresses, the candies will drop faster and faster, adding an extra layer of challenge to the game. With multiple levels and game modes to choose from, players will never get bored.

One of the key mechanics in Candy Strike Online is the concept of power-ups. These special candies can be used to clear the board, freeze time, or swap candies, giving players an edge in the game. Power-ups can be earned by clearing levels or purchased with in-game currency, making them a valuable tool for players who want to improve their skills.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Candy Strike Online are engaging, addictive, and challenging, making it a game that's perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
